description: UK private limited company deadlines: annual accounts to Companies House 9 months after year end (first accounts 21 months after registration), Corporation Tax payment 9 months and 1 day, CT600 12 months, with late filing penalties. UK (gov.uk), as of 2026-11-22. General information only: not tax or company-law advice, no filing. Weekends move to Monday; public holidays are not applied.
